en.name: Puck
en.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a non-Demon character: they die. If that character is not in play, also choose a player: they become that character.

revisions.v1: Once per game, at night*, choose a non-Demon character: they die. If that character is not in play, also choose a player: they become that character.
